questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion to emphasise the subject in a conditional clause?
options: If she had known the truth, she would have left immediately.
Had she known the truth, she would have left immediately.
She would have left immediately if she had known the truth.
She left immediately if she had known the truth.
questions.answer: Had she known the truth, she would have left immediately.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a cleft construction to highlight the reason for an action?
options: It was because of her determination that she succeeded in the exam.
The reason she succeeded in the exam was her determination.
She succeeded in the exam due to her determination.
Her determination was what led her to succeed in the exam.
questions.answer: The reason she succeeded in the exam was her determination.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical scenario involving a hypothetical situation?
options: He wishes he was a better writer.
He wishes he were a better writer.
He wishes he is a better writer.
He wishes he will be a better writer.
questions.answer: He wishes he were a better writer.

questions.question: Which sentence best demonstrates ellipsis in a formal context, omitting redundant elements while maintaining grammatical coherence?
options: The committee discussed the proposal, and it was ultimately rejected.
The committee discussed the proposal, and the proposal was rejected.
After the proposal was discussed, it was rejected by the committee.
The committee’s decision was made after the proposal was discussed.
questions.answer: The committee discussed the proposal, and it was ultimately rejected.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a complex sentence structure to convey nuanced contrast between two hypothetical scenarios involving conditional clauses?
options: Although she had studied hard, she would have failed if she had not taken extra lessons.
Had she not taken extra lessons, she would have failed, despite studying hard.
She failed because she did not study hard enough, but extra lessons would have helped.
If she had studied harder, she would not have needed extra lessons to pass.
questions.answer: Although she had studied hard, she would have failed if she had not taken extra lessons.
